description.p: Daftar is a native Rust desktop Markdown reader and knowledge studio. It renders Markdown with first-class right-to-left support for Persian and Arabic, Mermaid diagrams, syntax-highlighted code, footnotes and tables, and keeps a searchable library of highlights, bookmarks, flashcards and study roadmaps.
No JavaScript, WebView, Electron or Tauri: a single compiled binary.

ul.li: Persian/Arabic shaping, Unicode bidi and automatic direction detection
Mermaid subset rendering with pan, zoom and PNG export
PDF and PNG export with embedded fonts
Portable mode: run from a USB drive

description.p: Adds an Open With dialog to the library context menu for opening a document in a chosen external application, with safe argument passing and visible launch errors. Fixes translation templates that leaked format specs into the interface, including the reading progress shown in the status bar.
Redesigns the Library page with richer document rows (reading progress, tags, reading time), a sort selector, keyboard navigation and clearer filtering feedback.
Stabilizes indexing progress and cancellation, and adds importing Markdown text by pasting it directly into the library.
Fixes Persian Settings layout, including RTL tab and form alignment, compact-width behavior, and responsive window sizing.
Adds document PDF export with searchable RTL text, embedded fonts, images and rendered Mermaid diagrams. Fixes Windows release packaging.
Adds document PDF export with searchable RTL text, embedded fonts, images and rendered Mermaid diagrams. Fixes Windows release packaging.
Fixes the Windows packaging step of the release workflow and adds the document reading-width control, the RTL application layout and per-document reading width overrides.
First public release: native Markdown reader with RTL support, diagrams, knowledge library, exports, English/Persian UI and portable mode.
